parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL.
latest_user_direction: Finish the Magmaw 10N implementation with subagents.
objective: Remove the Mangle lethality and the ranged strand that killed the tank in b3-0dbce440-k1, then re-measure bundle 03 (already in master) together with these survival fixes as one 5-kill batch against baseline b2-fd4ba456 with 0 boss-window deaths.
hypothesis: b3 k1: the tank met Mangle at 46% with Vampiric Blood (health trigger at 50.2 s) and Icebound Fortitude (35% emergency at 60.3 s) already spent while the priest and druid stood 2.7 yd below the platform after a parasite contact-escape leg (straight-away 20 yd, no floor/path check) and retried a failing return for ~45 s; in the 6 s lead the tank cast Heart Strike x2 and Rune Strike with Death Strike rune-gated, so the 86.5k Mangle hit landed on no shield. Planning the tank's cooldowns around Magmaw's published Mangle timer (keep IBF for the hit, spend VB/Rune Tap in emergencies, hold VB's ordinary trigger near a Mangle, pre-cast VB when IBF is on cooldown, hold HS/RS until a Death Strike lands) keeps a defensive and Blood Shield up at every seize; validating escape/stage destinations against the native floor and a level round-trip path, and falling back after three native rejections, ends the strand; a healer within 35 yd with LOS keeps healing through Mangle. Fallen Crusader at 2 PPM (pinned WoWSims) and a Rune Tap row add tank throughput/survival lawfully. Expected: 0 boss-window deaths over 5 kills; Blood >= 0.95 (24.0k on b3 plus ~0.5k from 2 PPM); Balance and Elemental no longer lose kills to strands.
observations: b3-0dbce440-k1 timeline (last 25 s): no priest/druid healing on the tank from -25 to -4 s; Mangle hit 86.5k at 46% health; b2 k4 met Mangle at full health with IBF and Bone Shield up (37k hit).

Strand: priest/druid at (-308.5,-20.6,208.9) where no navmesh exists (nearest walkable 5.7 yd away, 2.9 yd above); warlock/shaman at (-314.4,-20.5,211.1) with only a z 220-224 ledge north; all parasites dead by 54 s yet no return until ~88 s (formation restore re-issued the same destination every tick; the escape alternate used the same geometry).
Fallen Crusader 3368: live spell_enchant_proc_data 1 PPM (TrinityCore 3.1.3 row); pinned WoWSims runeforging.go 2.0 PPM; 3.1.0 patch note 'chance to proc doubled'.
Dancing Rune Weapon is not held by any rule: it costs 60 runic power and is cast at the first affordable tick (smoke: 37 insufficient_resource rejections 97.9-101.7 s); no change.

Pre-existing failures reported: tests/test_fire_survival_combat_potions.py::test_actual_compiled_combustion_condition fails before and after (compiled stub harness); the 240 full-suite failures listed in bundle 03's plan are unchanged.
forbidden_changes: No invented auras, cooldown resets, damage/mitigation multipliers, health refills, Z steering, tolerance loosening or teleports; native pathing decides reachability.
No change to Magmaw's script or Mangle values, the Rune Weapon/glyph code of bundle 03, provisioning configs, WCL references, coefficients, the scoreboard or graph tooling.
acceptance_conditions: Declared tests pass; module_size reports no oversized file; an independent reviewer (separate subagent session, transcript-bound import-json) approves the exact diff.

A clean policy-bound build, one smoke kill, then a 5-kill scoreboard batch vs baseline b2-fd4ba456 judged with `scoreboard show --actor <id>` under the playbook keep rule; mechanism evidence: IBF or Vampiric Blood active at every seize, a Death Strike and Bone Shield >= 3 charges in the 6 s lead, no Mangle hit above ~50k, Rune Tap only below 60%, Unholy Strength ~12% of landed hits, no actor below the platform, no path_control_level_gap streak over ~5 s, healer casting gaps around Mangle under 4 s, priest heals on the Mangled tank.
0 boss-window deaths and every counted kill a native clear; otherwise the failing part is reverted.
This plan does not by itself accept any actor, the encounter or the parent objective.
